how to stop overthinking
so much all the time

1. give it a deadline

you can worry about it until 6pm.
after that, the decision is made.

2. ask: will this matter in a year?

most things won't.
the ones that will deserve real action, not loops.

3. give your mind something better to chew on

this morning i learned that victor hugo was living in exile on the island of guernsey when les misérables came out, in 1862.
my brain forgot what i was spiraling about.

this morning, the Sophia app taught me that victor hugo was living in exile on the island of guernsey when les misérables came out, in 1862.

slides.texte_overlay:
4. move your body

a walk around the block
changes the conversation in your head.

5. say it out loud to a friend

thoughts sound much smaller
once they leave your head.
which one do you need most?
